chapters.title: About Me
chapters.text: I'm currently a Ph.D. student in the School of Computing at National University of Singapore. I am generally interested in building high-quality software systems through various techniques, and also interested in how to leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), especially agentic approaches, in software engineering tasks. I love helping others and sharing knowledge, and enjoy teaching students.
